headline: First watch under $500: Hamilton Khaki Field NATO or bracelet?
stop_reason: Premise still not verified (attempt 3). Retailers and Hamilton list the black-dial NATO H69399930 at $725 (Watches of Switzerland, Abt, 2026; Hamilton US and Finland sites list $725 and EUR 675). No 2026 source found for a $495 navy bracelet Khaki Field. The only steel-bracelet figure is $445 for the quartz Khaki Field (Gear Patrol, undated), which is a different movement and is not a verified match. No clean, licensed Hamilton product photo found in the library (PH find returned no matches for H69399930 or Hamilton Khaki Field). Rejected sources: library (no match), Watches of Switzerland product pages (sign-up/unavailable state, no usable photo checked). Stopped rather than publish an unverified price pair. Suggest a brand-kit format or a different pairing for the backup slot.
